label: portable-law-probe
command: (require (quote [knoxx.backend.law.action-capabilities :as law]) (quote [clojure.edn :as edn])) (assert (= law/registry (edn/read-string (pr-str law/registry)))) (assert (law/spawn-context? {:spawn-agent! (fn [_ _] nil)})) (doseq [value [nil {} :spawn "spawn" #{} [] 1 false]] (assert (false? (law/spawn-context? {:spawn-agent! value})))) (println "Portable named EDN capability law PASS; no capability invocation")
